personality_one_liner: A fast, clean, and trustworthy utility emphasizing clear typography and immediate data retrieval for high-speed POS evaluation.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding for outer containers, but tight grouped spacing (sm/xs) for tabular price data so it can be scanned quickly.

do's: Use glassmorphism for the sticky bottom tab bar
Use glassmorphism for the sticky search header when scrolling through heavy result lists
Use glassmorphism on the sticky 'Condividi PDF' CTA container at the bottom of the Preventivo screen
dont's: Never use glassmorphism on individual list rows or the price pills
Do not blur the form inputs

screens.name: Cerca (Search)
screens.purpose: A high-speed lookup screen to type a game title and instantly see its valuation prices.

states.loading: Skeleton rows replicating the exact height and layout of a populated list item (cover box, title bar, three price pill bars).
states.empty: Clean empty state illustration with 'Nessun risultato. Cerca un altro titolo.' message and clear search input.
states.error: Readable text indicating a network issue with a 'Riprova' button.

screens.layout: Sticky large search input at the top (surfaceTertiary background). Flat list below. Each row uses a miniature table format: left-aligned square cover (48x48, radius sm), right side stacked with title and a 3-column price layout. Column 1 (Nuovo), Column 2 (Usato), Column 3 (Buyback). The Buyback price must visually dominate (wrapped in a brandTertiary pill with bold brandPrimary text). Include an icon button (e.g., plus) aligned right to add the item to Preventivo.

screens.name: Cronologia (History)
screens.purpose: View recent searches grouped by date to quickly re-evaluate games.

states.empty: Minimal icon indicating no history yet.

screens.layout: SectionList grouped by relative date ('Oggi', 'Ieri'). List rows are simplified versions of the search results, just cover, title, and the Buyback price.

screens.name: Preventivo (Quote)
screens.purpose: Review added games and generate a shareable PDF quote for the customer.

states.empty: Illustration showing an empty list with 'Nessun gioco aggiunto al preventivo.'
states.error: Error generating document, with retry button.

screens.layout: Header featuring the shop logo placeholder (VI initials in a circle) and a generated Quote ID. A clean list of the selected games displaying title and Buyback value. At the bottom, outside the scroll view, a sticky total summary (Totale Valutazione) sitting above a full-width primary CTA 'Condividi PDF'.

shop_logo_fallback.alt: VideogamesItalia Logo (Use 'VI' initials in a brand Primary circle as fallback since no real PNG was found via selector)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. This is a fast utility app, so avoid excessive decorative elements; prioritize data readability.
Typography: Use 'Geist' for all text, headings, and labels. Use 'Geist Mono' STRICTLY for all numerical prices to ensure tabular alignment and prevent layout shifting during price rendering.

Colors: Emphasize the 'Buyback' (valutazione) value by placing it inside a `brandTertiary` background pill with `brandPrimary` text. The Nuovo and Usato prices should just be standard `onSurface` or `onSurfaceSecondary` text without pills so Buyback stands out heavily.

Search Layout: Use the miniature table format discovered in research. The list row must not be too tall. Use a 48x48 square cover on the left. Stack the title and the 3-column prices (Nuovo, Usato, Buyback) neatly.

Preventivo Layout: Implement a sticky CTA at the bottom for the 'Condividi PDF' button. The content should scroll behind it using a glassmorphic container (or solid surface with top-shadow if glass fails).
Always wrap text over images with the strict gradient scrim pattern (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) if covers are used as headers, though here they are mostly thumbnails.
Ensure 'VideogamesItalia' logo uses a 'VI' initials avatar in a circle as a fallback, as the image selector did not find a valid real-world PNG.
